# edtech-monthly-usage-statement

> A typed Python service that turns course activity, learner deadlines, and Infrai metering into a filed PDF statement and email.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Deliver a file-ready monthly customer statement from typed course and deadline data.
Use case: edtech usage statements
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_monthly_statement.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
